meta.title: Juggling Cyprus · Free juggling meetup, every Tuesday 7pm in Larnaca
meta.description: A free, friendly juggling meetup at Larnaca Skate Park, every Tuesday from 7pm till late. Equipment to borrow, all levels welcome.
meta.ogDescription: Every Tuesday from 7pm at Larnaca Skate Park. Free, all welcome.
meta.ogAlt: The Juggling Cyprus badge: Cyprus, with three juggling balls thrown between the north coast and Larnaca.

hero.new: I’m new to juggling and want to try it

newbie.title: New to juggling?
newbie.intro: Perfect. Here’s how your first night goes.

steps.title: Turn up at 7pm
steps.body: No booking, no sign-up. Just come along to the skate park.

steps.title: Say hi
steps.body: Tell someone it’s your first time, and we’ll lend you some balls.

steps.title: Learn your first throws
steps.body: Start with one ball, then two, then three. There’s usually someone happy to show you the basics.

newbie.note: Feeling shy? {instagram} and we’ll look out for you.

countdown.on: On now. Come and join in!

welcome.title: Come and throw things.
welcome.p1: Juggling Cyprus is a free, drop-in meetup for anyone who likes throwing things in the air. First throws, rusty hands and old tricks are all welcome.
welcome.p2: Bring a ball if you have one. Empty hands are fine too: there’s plenty to borrow.
welcome.island: Wherever you’re from, north or south, near or far, there’s a space in the circle for you.

items.title: 7pm till late
items.body: Come at seven, stay as long as you like.

items.title: Always free
items.body: No fees, no sign-up. Just turn up.

items.title: Kit to borrow
items.body: No props? No problem. There’s equipment to borrow on the night.

items.title: Lit after dark
items.body: The park is lit, so we keep throwing after sunset.

items.title: Rain?
items.body: If the weather looks doubtful, check {instagram} before you head out.

items.title: All levels
items.body: Never juggled before? Perfect. Been at it for years? Also perfect.

find.title: Find us
steps: Head for the Tasos Mitsopoulos car park on the seafront road.
Walk through to the back of the car park, away from the sea.
We’re at the skate park, right next to the dog park.
find.mapLabel: Map: Larnaca Skate Park sits behind the Tasos Mitsopoulos car park, next to the dog park, a short walk from the beach.

footer.startTitle: Start a meetup in your town?
footer.start: Anywhere on the island, north or south, we’d love to help. Get in touch.
